sloka: दृष्ट्वा मुनिगणाः सर्वे पार्थिवाश्च महौजसः ।पिबन्त इव चक्षुर्भ्यां राजानं गायकौ च तौ ।। ७.९४.११ ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā munigaṇāḥ sarve pārthivāśca mahaujasaḥ ।pibanta iva cakṣurbhyāṁ rājānaṁ gāyakau ca tau ।। 7.94.11 ॥

translations.english: All the sages and mighty kings, having seen the king and those two singers, were as if drinking them in with their eyes.
